entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Unbelievable! I've been waiting for ten minutes! Is anyone even working today? This is ridiculous!
Thank you for your patience. My name is Isaac with VeloFit. I understand you've been waiting, and I apologize for that. How can I help you?
You can start by taking back these absolutely worthless cycling shoes I bought! I want a full refund, and I want it now!
I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The issue is that they're instruments of torture! They've given me the worst blisters of my life. I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, nothing works. They're completely unusable!
I'm very sorry to hear that the shoes are causing you blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your account. Can I get your order number?

It's 94-Alpha-32. Look, I don't want to troubleshoot anything. I want a refund. If you can't authorize that, put your manager on the phone right now. I am one click away from posting a review about this experience everywhere.

I understand your frustration. Let me just check your order details... Okay, I see the order for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes. It looks like they were delivered to you 81 days ago. One moment while I review the policy.
Don't you dare try to tell me I'm outside some window. This is a defective product!

No, not at all. Actually, you are well within our 90-day return period for a full refund. I can absolutely process that for you right now. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email on file.
...Oh. So, you're giving me a full refund? Just like that?

Yes, absolutely. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your refund will be credited back to your original form of payment within 3-5 business days. I do apologize again for the discomfort they caused.
Huh. Well... okay then. That's better. Thank you.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
